hero: I develop AI methods to model biological systems and guide therapeutic discovery. My current interests include virtual cells for precision medicine, therapeutic intervention design, and closed-loop AI for science.
description: Ziheng Duan — virtual cells for precision medicine, AI for therapeutic discovery, and closed-loop AI for science, grounded in graph learning for single-cell and spatial omics.
doctoral_bio: My doctoral research developed graph learning methods for single-cell and spatial omics, from genomic regulation to multi-slice tissue atlases.
heading: Current Research Interests
introduction: Modeling cellular responses, designing therapeutic interventions, and learning from scientific feedback.

interests.title: Virtual Cells for Precision Medicine
interests.description: Modeling cellular states and responses across diverse biological and patient contexts to support precision medicine.

interests.title: AI for Therapeutic Discovery
interests.description: Identifying therapeutic targets and designing interventions to steer disease-associated cells toward healthier states.

interests.title: Closed-Loop AI for Science
interests.description: Exploring AI systems that connect hypothesis generation, experimental design, and learning from experimental feedback.

phd.title: From Cells to Atlases
phd.subtitle: Graph Learning for Single-Cell and Spatial Omics
phd.description: My doctoral research developed graph learning methods for single-cell and spatial omics across biological scales—from chromatin organization and disease-associated gene networks to cellular microenvironments and multi-slice tissue atlases.
phd.dissertation_title: From Cells to Atlases: Mining Single-cell and Spatial Omics with Graph Learning

themes.title: Genomic & Cellular Analysis
themes.description: Reconstructing chromatin compartments, quantifying disease-associated network changes, and predicting disease states from single-cell data.

themes.title: Microenvironments & Intercellular Regulation
themes.description: Recovering spatial gene expression and modeling intercellular gene regulation within tissue microenvironments.

themes.title: Region Completion & Multi-Slice Integration
themes.description: Reconstructing missing spatial regions and integrating tissue slices for consistent joint analysis.
